name: SKMR4
notes: Kahles drawing SKMR4 for K318i/K525i (02023011293-106, 11.03.2020); FFP, so mrad values hold at every magnification. PUBLISHED dimensions used: crosshair line width 0.035 mil and centre dot dia 0.035 mil; 16 mil between the inner ends of the horizontal posts (posts start at +-8) and 8 mil from the horizontal line to the top post; post thickness 0.3 mil; 0.5 mil marks on the posts; 1 mil hash spacing (labels 2,4,6,8 / 10,15 on the posts); 0.2 mil subdivision spacing; 1 mil marks 0.5 mil wide and half-mil marks 0.25 mil wide on the vertical stadia; detail A: 0.2 mil and 0.5 mil marks below the tree rows; tree rows at every 1 mil below centre (labels 2..12). My mapping of the small dimension call-outs to elements (0.07 mil = length of the 0.2-mil subdivision marks, 0.15 mil = height of the 1-mil windage marks on the tree rows, 0.1 mil = length of the half-mil windage marks on the rows) is an interpretation of where the arrows point. MEASURED from the maker's to-scale drawing (vector PDF page 1, pixel scan at 17.0 pt per mil), NOT dimensioned: tree-row half-width = k/2 mil for row k (rows 1-14), windage marks on each row every 0.5 mil out to k/2-0.5 (whole-mil marks cross the row, half-mil marks hang below), which side each 0.2-mil subdivision mark sits on, the extra 0.1-mil fine scale between 3 and 4 mil on all arms (3.5 mil mark drawn 0.25 mil wide), the 1-mil marks on the horizontal line being 0.5 mil long (measured 0.53), post-mark length 0.5 mil (measured 0.54). Line widths of hash marks and tree rows are not published (width null). Not drawn: numerals; tree row 15 and stadia marks beyond 15.6 mil below centre and post marks beyond 15 mil (cut off by the drawing's circle); the drawing's posts begin at 7.95 mil vs the published 8 mil (published value used). Red elements (everything except the black posts and their marks) are the illuminated part.

notes: SOURCE: Vortex 'Reticle Subtensions' PDF https://vortexoptics.widen.net/view/pdf/2zfcnh7ax9/VTX_PST-1605_VMR-2_MOA_RS_I_RI_ST.pdf (linked from the product page in source_url; PDFs are served from Vortex's asset host vortexoptics.widen.net). Vortex labels the figure 'for representation only', but it is a vector drawing, so positions, lengths, spacings, line widths and dot sizes were read from the drawing (scale in PDF points per unit calibrated on the published dimensions below), then widths/diameters snapped to the published values where Vortex prints them (the drawing is within 3-12% of them). Numbers/text labels and the green dimension arrows are not drawn. Posts and lines that run to the edge go to +-500. WARNING: not first focal plane. vortexoptics.com lists the Viper PST Gen II 1-6x24 as Second Focal Plane and Vortex's own PDF says 'subtensions ... correspond to the highest magnification'; so the drawing is valid at 6x only (published_at_magnification = 6) and the whole reticle appears proportionally smaller at lower power. PUBLISHED and used: 35 (post inner edge), 45 (bottom post top), line .5, post thickness 1.75, centre dot dia .5 (PDF draws it larger), hash mark spacing 4 MOA. DRAWN: hash lengths (1.5 / 3 vertical bars). Illuminated = centre dot only (red in the diagram).

name: Dead-Hold BDC (MOA)
for_scope: Diamondback 4-12x40, Diamondback 3-9x40, Crossfire HD 3-9x40, Crossfire HD 4-12x44
notes: Shared by these scopes. Only the Diamondback 4-12x40 has its own subtension sheet (the source); the Diamondback 3-9x40 and Crossfire HD 3-9x40 and 4-12x44 follow Vortex's general Dead-Hold BDC chart (manual M-00240, same positions) and take their line widths from the 4-12x40 sheet by assumption. True at each scope's highest magnification. From the source sheet: Posts, crosshair, ticks, hold marks and dot positions/sizes read from the subtension image's callouts (pixel-measured against the 8 MOA / 11 MOA dimension lines). Published: crosshair .15, post width .6, posts start at 8 MOA (top/left/right) and 11 MOA (bottom), horizontal ticks at +-2/4/6 and 1 long, hold marks at 1.5/4.5/7.5 below centre; subtensions 'correspond to the highest magnification'. Not published, assumed: tick/hold-mark line thickness 0.2, hold-mark length 1.0 (measured), post taper 0.4 MOA, hold-mark/tick lengths from pixel measure.

name: Dead-Hold BDC (Diamondback 3.5-10x50)

name: Illuminated Dead-Hold BDC (MOA)
for_scope: Viper HD 3-15x44, Viper HD 2-10x42, Crossfire HD 2-7x32, Crossfire HD 6-18x50
notes: Shared by these scopes. Both Viper HD scopes have their own subtension sheets, which agree (the source). The Crossfire HD 2-7x32 and 6-18x50 are sold with the Illuminated Dead-Hold 2A; Vortex's 2A chart (manual M-00397, "All Other Riflescopes") gives the same positions, while its line widths and dot size are unpublished and taken from the Viper HD sheet, so the drawing is the same. True at each scope's highest magnification. (The Crossfire HD 1-4x24's Dead-Hold 2A is different and has its own entry.) From the source sheet: Posts, crosshair, ticks, hold marks and dot positions/sizes read from the subtension image's callouts (pixel-measured against the 8 MOA / 11 MOA dimension lines). Published: crosshair .3, post width .8, centre dot diameter .13 (illuminated), left/right posts start at 8 MOA, bottom post at 11 MOA, no top post (crosshair runs to the edge), ticks +-2/4/6 of length 1, hold marks 1.5/4.5/7.5; highest magnification. Not published, assumed: tick/hold-mark thickness 0.3 (pixel-measured), post taper 0.5 MOA, hold-mark length 1.0 (measured). Both Viper HD scopes sold with the illuminated Dead-Hold BDC (MOA) per product page.

name: Dead-Hold 2A BDC (Crossfire HD 1-4x24)
notes: Published (subtension image): 2 MOA illuminated centre dot, crosshair gap of 2 MOA around centre, line .5, posts 1.5 wide starting at 12 MOA left/right/top and 11.4 bottom, ticks at +-4 and +-8 (length 1.9), hold marks at 4.6 and 7.9 below; highest magnification (4x). Not published, assumed: tick/hold-mark thickness 0.6 and hold-mark length 2.1 (pixel-measured), post taper 0.6 MOA. Top post is symmetric with the left/right ones (12 MOA) as drawn in the diagram.

name: VMR-1 (Diamondback Tactical 4-12x40)
notes: Published (subtension image): crosshair .25, post width 1.7, posts start 18 MOA (left/right/top) and 30 MOA (bottom); hashmark lengths 1.5 and .7; highest magnification (12x). Not published: tick thickness (0.25 assumed equal to crosshair).

name: VMR-3 (Viper HD 5-25x50 SFP)
notes: The vortexoptics.com SFP product page (VPR-525-1) does not name the reticle but links the VMR-3 MOA manual (M-00356); the FFP model uses VMR-4. VMR-3 MOA drawn from the manual chart (18 MOA post starts, 30 MOA bottom post, 1.7 posts, .7/1.5 hashmark lengths, 2 and 4 MOA spacing) with no top post (vertical line runs to the edge). Widths and hash extents NOT published in this chart: taken from the VMR-1 drawing (crosshair .25 assumed). Reference magnification not stated for this scope; manual says 'typically the highest', so 25x is assumed.

name: AR-BDC3 (MOA)
